name: lispan_f01C_w96_inv
description: Li-SPAN forward PINN, 0.1 C, run C: run B (lispan_f01C_w96) plus the global charge-inventory residual (2 F c_S4,0 L_cat int (xi1+xi2+xi3) dY = Q(t), own weight group) and an EMA of the weights. Warm start from run B's final weights (--init), 10 000 steps at lr 2e-4 -> 1e-5. Run B's late-time voltage error (1 mV rms, 2.3 mV at the end) is the integrated extent-inventory drift (+1.6 mol/m3) appearing as a c_S2 deficit in phase 3.
